title: Canonical adic module quotient functors and transitions
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I$ an ideal. For an $R$-module $M$, put $I^nM=I^n\cdot M$ and $Q_n(M)=M/I^nM$, using the quotient module [def-weil-pbc-quotient-module]. For an $R$-linear map $f:M\to N$, define $Q_n(f)([x])=[f(x)]$. This defines an additive endofunctor $Q_n$ of the category of $R$-modules. Define the natural projection $p_n:\mathrm{id}\to Q_n$ by $p_{n,M}(x)=[x]$. For every $n\le m$, define the natural quotient transition $t_{m,n}:Q_m\to Q_n$ by $t_{m,n,M}([x])=[x]$, induced by $I^mM\subseteq I^nM$. Here $n=0$ is included. These are the existing AdicCohomology.power, quotient, projection and transition constructions, with their existing public names and unchanged data.
